sample_method: 100000 candidate pairs per image/axis/stride without replacement; seed=42+image_index*10000+stride; shared GT-valid coordinates across models
sign_definition: strict positive product, excluding GT exactly zero (abs<=1e-6); predicted zero is a mismatch
regression_definition: OLS signed predicted delta vs signed GT delta, with intercept; no calibration of predictions
limitations: GT Z-depth is camera-axis depth, not vertical crop height
No plant/ground segmentation; crop/ground ROI labels not asserted
MVS GT noise controls are diagnostic, not proof of noise-free ground truth
Detailed shape statistics are sampled; full zero baseline and existing full validation MAE separately reported
sampled_absolute_method: 100000 uniform candidate pixels per image, seed=420000+image_index; shared GT-valid coordinates; these are sampled, distinct from full validation metrics
